title: 美联储三年来首次加息25基点至3.75%-4%；沃什警告通胀过高且持续过久，16人预期年内再度加息
summary: 美联储FOMC以12-0一致票通过加息25基点，将联邦基金利率目标区间上调至3.75%-4%，为2023年7月以来首次加息。主席沃什在发布会上表示通胀过高且持续过久，最新点阵图显示18位官员中有16位预期年内将再次收紧。会后美股道指下跌1.21%（逾600点），标普500跌0.44%，美债10年期收益率升破5%，美元指数升至约100.3。
why: 全球资产定价最重要事件：首次加息确认美联储超预期鹰派立场，港股/A股跟跌，隐含波动率或攀升；sell put方向需提高警惕，留意行权价保护。

title: HKMA跟随美联储上调基准利率至4.25%；港股恒指9月17日跌逾1.2%进入调整区间
summary: 香港金融管理局宣布将贴现窗基本利率上调25基点至4.25%，为2023年7月以来首次。受美联储加息冲击，恒生指数9月17日盘中跌逾1.2%至约24,409点，较2026年高点累计跌幅超11%正式进入调整区间；恒生科技指数跌约1.8%。
why: 港股联系汇率制度下自动跟随美联储；加息加重地产、高股息类股压力，利率敏感资产承压；组合内腾讯、美团等个股回购或提供支撑但大盘拖累不容忽视。

title: Trump urges Fed to cut rates to 1% after rate hike, says he still has confidence in Chair Warsh
summary: President Trump responded to the Federal Reserve's first rate hike since 2023 by demanding rates fall to "1%, or less", posting that the US is "the Best Credit in the World — BY FAR." Trump said he still has confidence in Fed Chair Kevin Warsh despite the hike defying his explicit wishes to cut rates. The rate hike represented a significant defiance of Trump's wishes, as the president, vice president, and Treasury secretary had all urged the Fed not to raise rates.
why: 特朗普公开施压美联储降息，但明确表态仍信任沃什，意味着美联储独立性暂时维持；短期政治噪音，真正影响来自点阵图暗示的再加息路径。

title: Intel, SK Hynix shares jump on report they're discussing U.S. memory chip manufacturing at Intel Ohio fab
summary: Reuters reported SK Hynix is in early talks with Intel to produce memory chips in the U.S. for the first time, potentially using Intel's Ohio fab. Two scenarios discussed: SK Hynix leases part of Intel's Ohio facility, or forms a joint venture with Intel and cloud firms. Intel stock rose more than 4% on the day while SK Hynix shares also gained. SK Hynix confirmed it is "exploring various options" but no final decision has been taken.
why: 一箭双雕：若达成协议，英特尔代工业务获里程碑大客户，SK海力士完成美国产能布局；两个持仓均正面受益，watch IV ahead of potential formal announcement。

title: Crypto stocks sink after Senate rejects Clarity Act; Circle CRCL drops over 9%, Bitcoin slides toward 6,000
summary: The U.S. Senate failed a cloture vote 49-50 on the Digital Asset Market Clarity Act (CLARITY Act), falling far short of the 60 votes needed to advance. Crypto stocks and assets sold off sharply: Circle (CRCL) fell over 9% and Coinbase lost nearly 9%. Bitcoin fell more than 5% sliding toward 6,000. The bill's failure essentially ends market-structure legislative work in the Senate for 2026, leaving firms reliant on agency rules that future administrations could reverse.
why: Circle持仓重大利空：稳定币监管立法进程中断，监管不确定性重新抬头；期权隐含波动率显著上升，CRCL sell put需重新审视行权价保护余量。
